name: Owlbear
canary: CANARY — print-exact. Print's own row names must survive untouched.

description: a sellsword who hurls a handaxe and closes with a shortsword
canary: CANARY — plain weapon rows. Names must stay terse and match the weapon, not drift to flavour.

description: a brass tyrant whose furnace breath terrifies and whose hammer finds the terrified
canary: CANARY — a sheet that DOES frighten. A fear-promising name here is CORRECT and must not be suppressed.

description: a grasping thing of roots and wire that reaches for everyone who passes
canary: FEATURE — the fiction screams grapple. If the chassis grants none, no row may be called a Grasp, Grip or Snare.

description: a terror of the deep barrows, dread given a shape
canary: FEATURE — pure fear fiction, likely no Frightened row. Names must not promise terror the sheet cannot deliver.

description: a shouldering ram-beast that drives everything out of its way
canary: FEATURE — push/knockdown fiction. A Shove or Trip name needs an actual push in the text.

description: a pinning mantis-thing that holds its prey still while it feeds
canary: FEATURE — hold fiction across two rows; the classic Two-Arm Pin / Mire Grasp shape.

description: a paralysing horror whose gaze locks the limbs
canary: FEATURE — Paralyzed fiction at a CR where the chassis may not grant it.

description: a blinding sun-spirit that burns the sight from those who look at it
canary: FEATURE — Blinded fiction; also tests the element rule (Radiant) beside the mechanic rule.

description: a dread-piper whose tune drags the frightened closer
canary: FEATURE — fear AND pull in one concept; two mechanics a name could over-promise.
